newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Lee IPO 312.9 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wing Lee IPO 312.9 times subscribed.

text.p: Wing Lee Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its offer of 63 million shares to the public at HK$1.00 per share was 312.9 times subscribed.
The manufacturer of DC switches, jacks, AC sockets and speaker terminals will have market capitalisation of HK$280 million, its statement said.
Dealing in the stock is expected to begin on April 10.

The company said net proceeds of about HK$59.5 million from the issue would be used to expand and upgrade its production facilities and machinery in Hong Kong and China, and for repayment of bank loans and for working capital.
